cd_intro: Robo-Croc is hungry! Tap the arrows to show the way.
cd_level: Here's a new one! Find the fish!
cd_rocks: Watch out for rocks! Robo-Croc has to go around.
cd_go: Now tap the big green go button!
cd_empty: Tap the arrows first, then go!
cd_room: Whoa, lots of steps! Tap one to take it away.
cd_bonk: Bonk! Robo-Croc bumped. Let's fix the code!
cd_short: No fish yet! Robo-Croc needs more steps.
cd_loop: That's a long way! The loop does a step again and again.
cd_loophow: Tap the loop, then an arrow. More taps, more repeats!
cd_full: No more room! Try the loop block.
cd_more: Tap the loop block to make it repeat more!
cd_bug: Uh oh, a bug! One arrow is wrong. Tap it to fix!
cd_teach: Robo-Croc doesn't know what to eat. Can you teach him?
cd_test: Now Robo-Croc will try by himself. Watch!
cd_think: Hmm, I never learned this one. I'll guess!
cd_learn: Robots learn from the examples we give them!
bc_intro: Dad and Kyle need help! Find what's broken on the boat.
bc_remi: Help Dad check the boat! Tap the broken things.
bc_pegasus: This is Pegasus Five, a big workboat.
bc_cat: This is a sailing catamaran. It has two hulls!
bc_mackerel: This is Mackerel, a little aluminium boat.
bc_jacket: The life jacket's missing! Everyone needs one on a boat.
bc_crack: A crack! Fix it before it leaks.
bc_rust: Rusty rail! Give it a scrub and a paint.
bc_ext: The fire extinguisher's needle is in the red. It needs a refill!
bc_light: A broken light! Boats need lights at night.
bc_flag: A torn flag! Let's get a new one.
bc_anchor: The anchor's gone! Every boat needs an anchor.
bc_dinghy: Uh oh, a hole in the dinghy! Let's patch it.
bc_rope: A frayed rope! It could snap. Swap it out.
bc_fix: Righto, let's fix it all up!
bc_safe: Great survey! This boat is safe to go to sea.
dz_intro: Let's design a boat! Pick one.
dz_cat: A catamaran! Two hulls, nice and steady.
dz_banana: A banana boat! Hold on tight!
dz_tap: Tap a thing, then tap a side of the boat.
dz_side2: Put two on each side. Keep it level!
dz_side3: Put three on each side. Keep it level!
dz_tot4: Load four and keep it level!
dz_tot6: Load six and keep it level!
dz_tot8: Load eight and keep it level!
dz_limit: Fill her up close to the red line. Keep it level!
dz_r2: Put two things on the boat!
dz_r3: Put three things on the boat!
dz_rlevel: Make the boat level! Same on both sides.
dz_go: Nice and level! Off she goes!
dz_heavy: Glug glug! Too heavy! Take something off.
dz_tip: Whoa, wobbly! Make both sides the same.
dz_more: Room for more! Load a bit extra.
dz_less: A bit too much! Take one off.
dz_done: What a top boat designer! Dad would be proud.
